???+ remember "Before you start, remember"

    ??? question "What do we call a situation where the rules say nothing about what happens next, and can a well-formed v0.1 program reach it?"

        Undefined behavior. Vortex v0.1 does not intentionally expose it to well-formed programs.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 9. Runtime safety](../compiler/guide/stage-9-runtime-safety.md). Specification: [1. Conformance and terminology](../specification/conformance.md#15-undefined-behavior).

    ??? question "What do we call one trip over the whole program by one part of the compiler, doing one job?"

        A pass, such as checking types or lowering to IR.

        Introduced in [Build v0.1: 6. The first machine code](../compiler/guide/stage-6-first-machine-code.md).

    ??? question "What happens when a running Vortex program divides an integer by zero?"

        A runtime error. The program stops and reports what went wrong.

        Introduced in [Learn: 8. Runtime and numerical rules](../language-tour/06-runtime-and-numerical-rules.md). Specification: [10. Diagnostics](../specification/diagnostics.md#runtime-error).
